_meta.warning: FABRICATED DATA. No real Klarna customers, payments, or account records anywhere in this file.
_meta.why_only_four_records: Each record exists to drive exactly one verification path. See docs/DESIGN_SPECS.md Section 6.
_meta.why_no_cust_003: Deliberately absent. An unregistered customer_id is what drives the no_record path — the missing record IS the fixture, not an omission.

cust_001.role: Clean match — paid before the due date, amount exact. Drives the positive/auto-resolve case for both dispute types, and (paired with an ambiguous test message) low_confidence.

cust_002.role: Mismatch on both axes, no delay flag. Drives claim_mismatch for late_fee_dispute (date wrong) and independently for refund_request (amount wrong).

cust_004.role: Late payment, but the record itself flags a processing delay. Drives ambiguous_delay — the exact case Section 9 of the case study needs to exist. late_fee_dispute only; amounts match, so refund_request has no mismatch path through this record.
